arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test various alignment scenarios for R4
print('Testing alignment scenarios...')

# No alignment specified (default)
r = parse.parse('{x}', 'hello')
print('  {x} with \"hello\":', r.named if r else None)

# With width but no alignment  
r2 = parse.parse('{x:10}', 'hello     ')
print('  {x:10} with \"hello     \":', r2.named if r2 else None)

# With fill and align
r3 = parse.parse('{x:.>10}', '.....hello')
print('  {x:.>10} with \".....hello\":', r3.named if r3 else None)

# Zero-padded number
r4 = parse.parse('{x:05d}', '00042')
print('  {x:05d} with \"00042\":', r4.named if r4 else None)

# Signed number
r5 = parse.parse('{x:+d}', '+42')
print('  {x:+d} with \"+42\":', r5.named if r5 else None)
"
